data.name: Ahbabi
data.gender_notes: Ahbabi is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'habib' which means 'beloved'. Ahbabi is a unisex name indicating someone who is deeply loved. The name Ahbabi carries the meaning “My Love” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Ahbabi usually hope their child will grow to embody my love and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: In the Quran, Allah refers to the believers as His 'habib' (Quran 5:54).
data.etymology: Ahbabi belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “My Love.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ahbabi total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: أحبابي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من أحباب، يعني الشخص الذي يحبه الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم أحبابي مشتق من كلمة أحباب، وهي جمع حبيب، يعني الشخص الذي يحبه الناس ويحبه الله، ويدل على المحبة والوداد، وقد وردت هذه الكلمة في القرآن الكريم في سورة يس، الآية 12، حيث قال الله تعالى: 'أَحِبَّةً لَّنَا وَلَكِن لَّم يَكُن لَّهُم بِالْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَحَبَّةً'

in_english.name: Ahbabi
in_english.meaning: Derived from Ahbab, meaning one who is loved by people and Allah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Ahbabi is derived from the Arabic word 'ahbab', which means 'loved ones' or 'beloved'. This name signifies one who is cherished and loved by people and Allah. It reflects the values of love, compassion, and kindness. The root 'h-b-b' appears in the Quran, emphasizing the importance of love and affection in Islam. In Islamic tradition, this name holds spiritual significance, symbolizing a person's friendly and loving nature.

data.cultural_impact: The name Ahbabi holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic world. It is a name that evokes feelings of tenderness, love, and affection. In many Islamic societies, especially during specialized religious events like Hajj (pilgrimage to Mecca), the exchange of loving greetings and pet names like Ahbabi is common. This name forms a beautiful bond between family members, friends, and spouses alike.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Ahbabi symbolizes the love and devotion one has for Allah (God) and their fellow beings. It is a reminder that to truly understand love, one must first experience the boundless love and mercy of the Creator. By bearing this name, the bearer is encouraged to strive for self-improvement, upholding compassion and love, and nurturing deep connections with others and their Creator.
